clauses.standard_text: Receiving Party shall hold Confidential Information in strict confidence for a period of 3 years from the date of disclosure and use it only for the Purpose stated in this agreement.
No license to any intellectual property is granted under this agreement. All Confidential Information remains the property of the Disclosing Party.
Either party may terminate this agreement with 30 days' written notice. Confidentiality obligations survive termination for the stated period.
This agreement shall be governed by the laws of the Disclosing Party's principal place of business.
